subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept the scoped same-agent live orphan transcript fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261, fold it into the broader private recall design, or keep store-missing live transcript hits hidden?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but changing which private transcripts can surface through `memory_search` is a transcript-visibility and upgrade behavior decision that automation should not settle.

options.title: Accept Scoped Live-Orphan Fallback
options.body: Land the targeted fallback after maintainer approval because it preserves cross-agent and basename-only fail-closed behavior while fixing the reported same-agent orphan case.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Private Recall
options.body: Defer the runtime fallback into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100140 if maintainers want one product surface for all cross-private-conversation recall behavior.

options.title: Keep Live Orphans Hidden
options.body: Reject the fallback and require session-store metadata to exist before live transcript hits can surface, preserving the current fail-closed behavior at the cost of missed recall.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Live-Orphan Fallback
recommendation.body: Land the targeted fallback after maintainer approval because it preserves cross-agent and basename-only fail-closed behavior while fixing the reported same-agent orphan case.

likelyOwner.reason: The related maintainer-labeled product PR owns the broader private recall direction and overlaps the transcript security boundary decision.
